items: 【Cutting Edge Technology】This 11 inch tablet is equipped with the latest Android 14 system. With smarter notification management, the latest five-finger gesture control, and split-screen management, it brings you more powerful privacy control and optimization, and smoother multitasking between applications, allowing you to experience the excellent features of the real cutting-edge technology.

【Extreme Performance】The latest storage upgrade for Android 14 tablets, 128GB ROM + 16GB RAM + 512GB additional expansion, optimizes and supports platforms such as Netflix, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and has the latest delay-free experience. Whether you are playing games, listening to music, watching videos or working, you can ensure ultra-smooth performance without worrying about insufficient space.

【4G Wireless Communication】The 11 inch Android 14 tablet has built-in 4G LTE calling function and supports dual SIM cards, allowing you to access high-speed Internet anytime, anywhere. It is equipped with 5G WiFi and Bluetooth 5.0 for ultra-fast downloads and seamless wireless pairing. It can maintain a strong signal in any environment, whether in the office, cafe, hotel or on the road, you can enjoy smooth video calls, low-latency cloud access, and advanced antenna technology ensures a stable connection even in crowded networks.

【11 inch Ultra-Clear Large Screen】The Android 14 tablet has the clearest 11 inch visual experience, making every detail come alive, the large 16:10 screen ratio provides amazing clarity and vivid colors to enhance your viewing experience, and the advanced soft light diffusion layer reduces eye fatigue, allowing you to watch comfortably for longer, whether you are streaming movies, playing games or editing photos, every image has excellent details and realistic color accuracy.

【8000mAh All-Day Powerhouse】This 11 inch Android tablet is equipped with a 8000mAh large-capacity lithium polymer battery, providing 24-hour standby at any time, more than 8 hours of video playback, allowing you to enjoy your favorite series uninterrupted, 6 hours of high-intensity game marathon, allowing you to dominate every aspect, and the universal Type-C charging method allows you to quickly and easily recharge the tablet.

【Smart Life】This 11 inch Android 14 tablet, with fully upgraded security features, Face Unlock, just a glance for safe and instant access; Parental Control, create safe browsing areas and application restrictions for children; One-Click Screen Recording, instantly capture precious moments; Built-in GPS and Offline Maps, navigate anywhere without cellular data.

【Best Choice】The portable Android tablet that meets your new daily needs and easily adapts to your lifestyle, whether you are working, studying or having fun. Small and fully functional, it is the first choice for business people. It is durable and easy to carry, a must-have for students. With intuitive interface control and easy-to-understand option adjustments, it is an excellent tablet for the elderly. A high-performance tablet suitable for everyone and meeting various needs.

【Professional After-sales Team】MoonStars tablet professional team has been focusing on security and product advancement for more than ten years, adhering to the principle of customer first. If you have any questions, please let us know so that we can provide timely help and quality service to ensure that you use this Android 14 tablet safely and happily.
